mechanism: Paroxetine increases serotonergic activity which may antagonize levodopa's dopaminergic effects and increase risk of serotonin syndrome; paroxetine also inhibits CYP2D6 which metabolizes some levodopa pathways.
action: Monitor for reduced antiparkinsonian efficacy and serotonin syndrome symptoms; consider alternative antidepressant with lower CYP2D6 inhibition such as sertraline or citalopram if possible.
